newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish budget deficit up to PLN 5.54 bln in August.
newsitem.headline: Polish budget deficit up to PLN 5.54 bln in August.

text.p: Poland's budget deficit widened by 234 million in August to total 5.541 billion zlotys for January-August, which accounted for 54.5 percent of the planned 1996 deficit of 10.16 billion zlotys, the finance ministry said.
In August the treasury increased its planned 1996 budget gap by 659 million zlotys to 10.159 billion after taking into account foreign loans for restructuring of state-owned firms.

NOTE: Jan-July figures given as reported last month. Previous 1996 budget deficit plan in brackets.
